sentences.text: Exemption allowed subject to just exceptions.

The instant appeal under Section 173 of Motor Vehicle Act, 1988 has been filed on behalf of the appellant seeking the following reliefs:
"a. allow the present appeal and recall the entire Trial Court Record in the present case; AND b. the judgment/Award dated 02.03.2023, PASSED by the court of Dr.
Kamini Lau, Ld. PO-MACT (Central District), Tis Hazari Courts, Delhi in case vide MACT No.983/2021 may kindly be modified and the appellant may be awarded a sum of Rs.30,00,000/- (Rupees Thirty Lakhs only) as compensation with interest @12% per annum from the date of filing of the claim petition till payment, against the respondents.
c. Pass any other order or direction that this Hon'ble Court, in This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 17/07/2024 at 06:04:47 its wisdom, may deem fit and just to ensure a fair,
just, and equitable determination of compensation in accordance with the actual financial loss suffered by the family of the deceased."
